# Code of conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our commitment

Contributors, maintainers and users should be able to participate without harassment or discrimination. Treat others respectfully regardless of background, experience, identity or technical preferences.

## Expected behavior

Offer constructive feedback, keep discussions relevant to the project, respect privacy, give credit to others and acknowledge mistakes. Critique code and design rather than people.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, threats, discriminatory insults, disclosure of someone else's private information, spam and deliberate disruption are not acceptable.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to **i.am@dangkhoa.dev**, including a concise account and any relevant links. Maintainers may moderate, hide or remove harmful content and limit participation where necessary. Reports are handled as availability permits.

This community policy concerns interaction in this repository; it does not modify the [MIT license](../LICENSE).
